Bharadwaja.note: A great sage; Drona was born of his seed kept in a vessel (drona).

people.Drona: Preceptor in arms to both Kaurava and Pandava princes; brahmin by birth, warrior by trade, commander of the Kaurava host after Bhishma.

Sharadvan.note: A sage of the Gautama line; father of the twins Kripa and Kripi, born in a clump of reeds and raised in the Kuru court.

people.Kripa: Twin of Kripi; a chiranjivi and early teacher of the Kuru princes, he survived the war.

Kripi.note: Twin of Kripa; wife of Drona and mother of Ashwatthama.

people.Ashwatthama: Son of Drona and Kripi, born with a gem in his brow; a chiranjivi cursed to wander after he slew the Pandava sons in their sleep.
